name: Moonlit Field
source:
A little detour from his boring daily life led Ryan to an unexpected turn of events. Follow his story as he meets a grey wolf they share some secret talks at a moonlit field.

[From [url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/moonlit-field]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
瑞安在无聊的日常生活中稍稍偏离了一步，结果发生了意想不到的转折。跟随他的故事，了解他遇到一只灰狼的故事，他们在月光下的田野里进行一些秘密谈话。

[来自[url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/moonlit-field]Itch.io[/url]]
